behavior: An agent editing a source file on disk and then calling java_definition through the real shim-to-daemon-to-JDT-LS pipeline gets a routed answer that is either post-edit or an explicit resync error, never the pre-edit (stale) answer.
rationale: Only observable by driving the real shim over a real socket to a daemon that routes to a real JDT LS — the matrix's e2e_scenario for the process boundary [INV-SYNC-1][INV-ROUTE-1]; falsifies a daemon that answers a post-edit call from the pre-edit model, or routes the call to the wrong workspace.
